fields.description: TCP Directo: Frappe opens a raw socket to Host:Port itself (needs direct network access to the printer). Puente Android: the ticket is published in real time to an Android bridge device (see Bridge User) that relays it over a local TCP connection to Host:Port — needed when Frappe runs off-site from the printer's LAN.
fields.label: Delivery Mode

fields.description: The Frappe User the paired Android bridge device logs in as. Print jobs for this printer are published via frappe.publish_realtime to that user's active sessions — create one dedicated User per bridge device/phone.
fields.label: Bridge User

fields.description: IP address or hostname of the network printer, on the local network the printer physically lives on (in Puente Android mode, this is the address the bridge device connects to — not Frappe).
fields.label: Host

fields.description: Optional. A Print Format with Raw Printing enabled, whose Raw Commands lay the ticket out (Jinja + ESC/POS). Leave blank to use the built-in layout driven by the checks in Restaurant Settings. Must be for Restaurant Order on a kitchen printer and for POS Invoice on a till printer. The codepage, cut, drawer and copies below still apply either way.
fields.label: Print Format (Raw)

fields.description: Override the numeric ESC/POS code-table id if this printer doesn't follow the standard numbering for the codepage above.
